title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 1: Checking what is visible
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Veo una fecha distinta en el documento.
sentences.en: I see a different date on the document.

sentences.target: ¿Ves el mismo cambio en tu copia?
sentences.en: Do you see the same change in your copy?

sentences.target: Ana vio el aviso esta mañana.
sentences.en: Ana saw the notice this morning.

sentences.target: Todavía no hemos visto a la directora.
sentences.en: We have not seen the director yet.

sentences.target: Cuando la veamos, confirmaremos la información.
sentences.en: When we see her, we will confirm the information.

sentences.target: Mientras tanto podemos comparar las dos versiones.
sentences.en: Meanwhile we can compare the two versions.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 2: Events, routes and time spent
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: ¿Qué pasó con la reserva de la sala?
sentences.en: What happened to the room booking?

sentences.en: There we spent ten minutes looking for the message.

sentences.en: The coordinator asked us to go into another office.

sentences.en: While we were waiting, the person in charge went by.

sentences.target: Él encontró la confirmación en su teléfono.
sentences.en: He found the confirmation on his phone.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 3: Carrying out an activity
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: El centro realiza una encuesta después de cada curso.
sentences.en: The center carries out a survey after each course.

sentences.en: This week we are conducting two interviews.

sentences.target: Ayer realizamos la primera prueba del programa.
sentences.en: Yesterday we carried out the program's first test.

sentences.target: ¿Quién va a realizar la revisión final?
sentences.en: Who is going to carry out the final review?

sentences.target: La coordinadora quiere realizarla con todo el equipo.
sentences.en: The coordinator wants to carry it out with the whole team.

sentences.target: Así podremos comparar las respuestas.
sentences.en: That way we will be able to compare the answers.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 4: Finding what a team needs
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Encuentro la dirección en el último mensaje.

sentences.en: My coworker found another copy of the document.

sentences.en: We did not find the participant list yesterday.

sentences.target: Si encuentras el archivo, avísame.
sentences.en: If you find the file, let me know.

sentences.target: La coordinadora espera que encontremos una solución hoy.
sentences.en: The coordinator hopes we find a solution today.

sentences.target: Podemos revisar juntos la carpeta del grupo.
sentences.en: We can review the group's folder together.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 5: Wants and a change of subject
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Quiero revisar la propuesta antes de votar.
sentences.en: I want to review the proposal before voting.

sentences.target: Ana quiere que todos tengamos una copia.
sentences.en: Ana wants all of us to have a copy.

sentences.en: Do you want to present your idea first?

sentences.target: No queremos cambiar la fecha sin preguntar.
sentences.en: We do not want to change the date without asking.

sentences.target: Ayer quería llamar, pero no tuve tiempo.
sentences.en: Yesterday I wanted to call, but I did not have time.

sentences.target: Hoy podemos hablar con la coordinadora.
sentences.en: Today we can talk with the coordinator.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 6: Arrivals and deadlines
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Llego al centro media hora antes de la clase.
sentences.en: I arrive at the center half an hour before class.

sentences.en: Yesterday I arrived after the meeting had begun.

sentences.en: What time did the materials arrive?

sentences.target: Todavía esperamos que llegue la última caja.
sentences.en: We are still waiting for the last box to arrive.

sentences.target: Si llega hoy, podremos terminar mañana.
sentences.en: If it arrives today, we will be able to finish tomorrow.

sentences.target: La recepcionista nos llamará cuando la reciba.
sentences.en: The receptionist will call us when she receives it.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 7: Placing, setting and proposing

sentences.target: Pongo las nuevas fechas en el calendario.
sentences.en: I put the new dates on the calendar.

sentences.target: Ya hemos puesto los documentos en orden.
sentences.en: We have already put the documents in order.

sentences.target: ¿Puedes poner un ejemplo más sencillo?
sentences.en: Can you give a simpler example?

sentences.target: No pongas los datos privados en el mensaje del grupo.
sentences.en: Do not put private details in the group message.

sentences.target: Primero vamos a revisar quién necesita cada copia.
sentences.en: First we are going to check who needs each copy.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 8: Taking items and tracking duration

sentences.target: Llevo los documentos a la otra oficina.

sentences.target: Yo las llevaré si puedo usar el coche.
sentences.en: I will take them if I can use the car.

sentences.target: Después regresaré al centro para la reunión.
sentences.en: Afterward I will return to the center for the meeting.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 9: Continuing after an interruption

sentences.en: We are still waiting for an answer from the office.

sentences.target: Ana sigue revisando los nombres.
sentences.en: Ana is still checking the names.

sentences.target: Ayer seguimos trabajando después del almuerzo.

sentences.en: Follow the instructions on the first page.

sentences.target: No sigas usando la copia antigua.
sentences.en: Do not keep using the old copy.

sentences.target: La nueva está en la carpeta compartida.
sentences.en: The new one is in the shared folder.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 10: Information, skills and discovering a fact

sentences.en: We do not know who changed the date.

sentences.target: Ayer supe que la directora estaba de viaje.
sentences.en: Yesterday I learned that the director was away.

sentences.target: ¿Sabes si volverá antes del viernes?
sentences.en: Do you know whether she will return before Friday?

sentences.target: Ella quiere que sepamos dónde pedir ayuda.
sentences.en: She wants us to know where to ask for help.

sentences.target: Podemos guardar el número de la oficina central.
sentences.en: We can save the central office's number.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 11: People, places and first meetings

sentences.en: I met her at a meeting last year.

sentences.en: We do not know the new building yet.

sentences.en: Do you want to meet the rest of the team?

sentences.en: I hope everyone knows the plan before Monday.

sentences.target: Mañana podremos recorrer las salas juntos.
sentences.en: Tomorrow we will be able to tour the rooms together.

subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Creo una carpeta para cada proyecto.

sentences.en: We are creating a guide for visitors.

sentences.target: Después lo probaremos con el grupo nuevo.

title: Spanish Usage-First Verbs core 13: Presenting, introducing and submitting
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Así sabremos quién puede ayudar con cada tarea.

sentences.en: Do they allow materials to be stored here overnight?
